headline: Recommended $43,500,000 in bonds for a Public Works garage and fleet facility, plus wastewater, landfill, and pool bonds
summary: The committee recommended final passage of seven bond and loan measures. It also recommended changing the purpose of up to $3,183,200 in unexpended bond proceeds to the garage and fleet maintenance project. Each motion carried.
decisions: Recommended final passage of up to $3,000,000 in bonds or a state loan for Wastewater Treatment Plant Phase 1 upgrades; motion carried.
Recommended final passage of bonds not to exceed $4,275,000 for sewer infrastructure and sewer and drain casting replacement programs; motion carried.
Recommended final passage of bonds not to exceed $2,550,000 for various wastewater capital improvements; motion carried.
Recommended final passage of bonds not to exceed $2,000,000 for various improvements at the Solid Waste Department Four Hills Landfill; motion carried.
Recommended final passage of bonds not to exceed $2,678,828 for the purchase of solid waste capital equipment; motion carried.
Recommended final passage of bonds not to exceed $5,000,000 for the repair and renovation of two public inground swimming pools; motion carried.
Recommended final passage of bonds not to exceed $43,500,000 for the design, construction and equipping of a Division of Public Works garage and fleet maintenance facility; motion carried.

Recommended final passage of changing the purpose of up to $3,183,200 in unexpended bond proceeds from various Division of Public Works capital projects to the garage and fleet maintenance facility project; motion carried.
